title: The extended Fargues--Scholze spectral action
summary: Let $G$ be a connected reductive group over a non-archimedean local field. The main result of Fargues and Scholze [FS21] for the geometrization of the local Langlands correspondence is the construction of a ``spectral action'' on the category of $\ell$-adic sheaves on $\text{Bun}_{G}$, the stack of $G$-torsors on the Fargues-Fontaine curve. The goal of this paper is to prove a conjecture of Fargues which says that one can extend this construction to the larger stack $\text{Bun}_G^e$ of $G$-torsors on the Kaletha gerbe over the curve, as introduced by Fargues [Far22].
